english.value: Never thought I'd end up in North Africa. It's the hottest place I've ever been. The OSS thinks the Germans are testing secret weapons in the desert. The Germans are supposed to be working on some new thing called a Tiger Tank. Direct orders are to take 'em out...and whatever else we find. I'm tracking a guy named Brecht; he's another of Von Schrader's men. I'm with a forward patrol - closing in on their position...
